propositions: Changing ticket type does not invalidate stored plan-review attestations, causing stale verdicts to be replayed under inapplicable scoring criteria.

Type gates scoring in four places (bug_tier, exemptions for bug/session_log/code_review/identity), so a plan passing as 'bug' and retyped to 'task' incorrectly carries forward its PASS despite now being subject to additional criteria.
Both reuse paths (idempotent_reuse and verdict_reuse) in reuse.py check material fingerprint and base_sha but never compare stored ticket_type against current ticket_type.
The REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already records ticket_type but it is never read during reuse decision-making, leaving the data available but unused.
Reuse functions must fail open by returning None when stored and current types differ, preserving legitimate reuse for sidecars with absent or empty type.
material_fingerprint must remain unchanged to avoid invalidating all existing attestations; type comparison occurs only at reuse gate, not in fingerprint basis.
